rapport_notes: Friendly opening and recovery from audio issues, but call tone remains transactional throughout; customer engagement is functional, not warm.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; silence not consistently held after open-ended questions (e.g., 'any questions so far' met with immediate pivot rather than pause).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: MISSING — no time-boxed ask + promise of accurate quote framing before probing begins
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks: 'I'd like to check maybe you have any specific concerns or what are you most worried about for the upcoming so we can address it now?' — asked AFTER extensive logistics/inventory probing (apartment floors, elevator distances, item lists, etc.). Customer responds with single concern: same-day delivery.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises same-day move concern. Rep addresses once ('won't be able to finish in one day... we'll divide it ten to two days'), explains overnight hotel plan ('Does that make sense so far?'). No follow-up dig ('tell me more about that timing pressure,' 'what else worries you'). Concern acknowledged but not two-layer explored.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: NEVER COVERED — no 'what items do you need us to be careful with' question asked; customer volunteered 'nothing super crazy' only after Amy asked about gun safes/pianos, not a proactive carefulness inquiry.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: NEVER COVERED — no mention of Meet Your Mover, named crew lead, or who will actually be on the truck.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: NEVER COVERED — no mention of on-time commitment, guarantee, or penalty/credit language.
evidence_quotes.communication: NEVER COVERED — no day-before call, named crew lead, or inbox/text update protocol mentioned.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial — rep gives hourly rates ($202/hr Sunday, $204/hr Monday) and time estimates (2.5 hrs load day 1, 3–4 hrs unload day 2, 4 hrs drive), but does NOT anchor to 'a typical one-bedroom takes X movers Y–Z hours' range; personalization based on floor/distance is present (6th floor, 15th floor, 4-hour drive cited) but without the standard industry anchor.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_window: Rep states: 'it's just an estimate basically on each day, you'll only pay for the actual time to you' — the window concept is touched, but specific factors driving variability are not named (e.g., 'could be faster if boxes staged, or slower if reassembly takes longer').
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: NEVER COVERED — no mention of 15-min increments, 'if we beat the estimate you pay less,' or similar credit structure.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Rep states: 'if you're able to stage the boxes near the door or break down the bed in advance, that would really help you save time and of course money by the end of the day.' — self-prep tip IS present.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_silence: Rep does NOT ask 'does that feel fair?' after the estimate; asks 'Questions so far?' and customer replies 'No, no question so far that makes sense' — no silence held, immediate pivot to booking.
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock: NEVER MENTIONED — no 'your rate locks when you book' language.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: WEAK — rep says 'if you're ready to book we don't require any deposits' (permissive phrasing, not 'would you like our help with your move'), then customer declines ('I'll need some time... talk to my fiancé'), and rep accepts without re-ask or confirmation of next steps.

top_strength: Amy delivered a clear, detailed estimate breakdown with accurate pricing, included all three locations, and correctly explained the two-day logistics plan; customer understood the structure and acknowledged it made sense.
coaching_note: Front-load discovery with a quid pro quo framing and their-agenda question BEFORE logistics probing, then dig two layers deep on every concern raised (here: same-day move urgency); hold silence after open-ended questions; and deliver the Stage 2 takeaway (On-Time Guarantee + Communication + Meet Your Mover) for differentiators not yet covered — none were delivered on this call.
